integrity: The proof and finite verifiers are included. Finite checks are corroboration, not a replacement for the combinatorial proof and classical design existence theorem. Earlier unindexed equivalent directed-design results cannot be excluded.
scientific_limitations: Exact capacity equality is proved only for alphabet orders congruent to three modulo six; other orders and enumeration of inequivalent optimal codes are unresolved. The construction uses classical resolvable triple systems.
title: Sharp three-symbol, one-deletion, two-list codes from Kirkman triple systems
